weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:start: Data covers the "60" value label of the 1950s bar, which is the number the whole story rests on. Then seg1:mid and seg1:end cut to a generic seesaw that shows a mid-animation "30.6" and then "57.4" against "0.9" and then "1.7", with the bottom half of the frame empty.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The mascot is placed at the tip of the bar without checking what it hides. The seesaw is a stock balance machine with a subject-agnostic scale, and the viewer reads its counting-up values as the real numbers.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Keep Data clear of every value label, or move the label. Replace the seesaw with a picture made of the pit stop: a 1950s car sitting in the box while a crew clock runs to 60s, next to a modern car that is in and out in 1.8s, run in real time side by side. Only final values may appear, never interpolated ones like 30.6 or 57.4.
